scope: Canonical public Admin APIs with real OTP/TOTP and owned disposable QA records. Existing customer accounts, published models and balances are not modified.

checks.name: administrator signs in with fresh real OTP/TOTP and highest-admin authority
highest admin creates two OTP-required users; replay retains one original operation and identity
duplicate user email is rejected before any identity is created
admin creates two real workspaces with exact owners, initial projects and billing accounts
bulk freeze changes exactly the selected two user accounts
stale batch versions are rejected without partially restoring any selected account
bulk workspace suspension and restoration apply atomically to the selected records
even highest admin cannot delete the only active workspace owners
